entities.name: Fundamento de Esperanto
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: The Fundamento de Esperanto, a foundational text of the Esperanto language, was created in 1905 by L. L. Zamenhof. This book outlined the basic grammar and vocabulary of Esperanto, establishing it as the only obligatory authority over the language. The Fundamento de Esperanto has had a profound impact on the development of Esperanto, shaping its structure and usage. It has also influenced the creation of other language learning resources and has been widely used as a textbook for Esperanto courses. The Fundamento de Esperanto is considered a seminal work in the history of Esperanto, and its significance extends beyond the language itself, reflecting broader societal and cultural trends of the early 20th century. As such, it is a significant regional development in the context of Esperanto's growth and spread, particularly in Europe and beyond.
